title: Callbacks and Tracing
summary: This module provides core functionalities for handling asynchronous and synchronous callbacks, managing execution traces, and dispatching custom events within LangChain applications. It enables detailed logging, monitoring, and integration with tracing platforms like LangSmith.

nodes.label: LLM, Chain, Tool, Agent, Retriever Components
nodes.title: Operational Components
nodes.description: Represents the various LangChain components (LLMs, Chains, Tools, Agents, Retrievers) that generate events during their execution, which are then processed by callback handlers and tracers.

nodes.label: Define Asynchronous Event Handlers
nodes.title: Asynchronous Callback Interface
nodes.description: An abstract base class defining asynchronous methods for handling various events (start, end, error, new token) across LLM, chain, tool, agent, and retriever runs. It serves as the foundation for custom async callback logic.

nodes.label: Log Events to File
nodes.title: File Logging Callback
nodes.description: A concrete callback handler that writes detailed event logs (chain start/end, agent actions, tool outputs, text) to a specified file, supporting both append and write modes. It can be used as a context manager for proper file handling.

nodes.label: Group Synchronous Operations for Tracing
nodes.title: Synchronous Chain Group Tracing
nodes.description: A synchronous context manager that groups multiple related operations into a single logical 'chain group' run for tracing purposes, facilitating organized monitoring in platforms like LangSmith.

nodes.label: Group Asynchronous Operations for Tracing
nodes.title: Asynchronous Chain Group Tracing
nodes.description: An asynchronous context manager that groups multiple related asynchronous operations into a single logical 'chain group' run for tracing, enabling structured monitoring of concurrent processes.

nodes.label: Dispatch Synchronous Custom Events
nodes.title: Synchronous Custom Event Dispatcher
nodes.description: A utility function to synchronously dispatch ad-hoc custom events to registered callback handlers, allowing for flexible, user-defined event signaling within an existing run context.

nodes.label: Dispatch Asynchronous Custom Events
nodes.title: Asynchronous Custom Event Dispatcher
nodes.description: A utility function to asynchronously dispatch ad-hoc custom events to registered callback handlers, supporting flexible, user-defined event signaling within an existing asynchronous run context.

nodes.label: Collect LLM Usage Metadata
nodes.title: Usage Metadata Collector
nodes.description: A context manager that provides a callback handler to track and aggregate usage metadata, such as token counts, from chat model calls, offering insights into resource consumption.

nodes.label: Collect All Traced Runs
nodes.title: Run Collector Context Manager
nodes.description: A context manager that captures and stores all LangChain runs (LLM calls, chain executions, tool invocations) that occur within its scope, providing a programmatic way to access run data.

nodes.label: Manage Run Lifecycle & Tracing Data
nodes.title: Abstract Tracing Core
nodes.description: An abstract base class that defines the fundamental logic for creating, updating, and managing the lifecycle of runs (LLM, chain, tool, retriever) and their associated events, including handling parent-child relationships and error reporting for tracing.

nodes.label: Process Streaming Output for Tracing
nodes.title: Asynchronous Stream Consumer
nodes.description: An asynchronous function that consumes a stream of output chunks from a runnable, reconstructs the evolving final output, and dispatches `RunLogPatch` events for real-time logging and UI updates during streaming operations.

nodes.label: LangSmith Tracing Platform
nodes.title: External Tracing Service
nodes.description: An external platform for visualizing, debugging, and evaluating LangChain applications by collecting and displaying detailed run traces and metadata.

nodes.label: Local File System
nodes.title: Local Storage
nodes.description: The local storage where the FileCallbackHandler writes its logs and event data.

groups.label: User-Facing Utilities
groups.title: User-Facing Utilities
groups.description: Components that provide direct utility to users for logging, collecting run data, or tracking specific metrics.

groups.label: Event/Run Initiation
groups.title: Event/Run Initiation
groups.description: Components responsible for initiating new runs, grouping operations, or dispatching custom events within the callback and tracing system.

groups.label: Core Tracing Logic
groups.title: Core Tracing Logic
groups.description: Abstract and concrete components that manage the internal state, lifecycle, and processing of tracing data.

groups.label: Callback Interface
groups.title: Callback Interface
groups.description: The foundational abstract class for defining how asynchronous events are handled across the system.
